CLASSES=$(ls data/answers/*.json | wc -l)
ANSWERS=$(jq -s '[.[] | .answers | length] | add' data/answers/*.json)
TITLE_ANSWERS=$(sed -n 's/.*Pre-Solve Lab · \([0-9]\+\) verified.*/\1/p' site/index.html)
DESC_CLASSES=$(sed -n 's/.*pre-solve lab: \([0-9]\+\) problem classes.*/\1/p' site/index.html)
DESC_ANSWERS=$(sed -n 's/.*pre-solve lab: [0-9]\+ problem classes with \([0-9]\+\) verified answers.*/\1/p' site/index.html)
OG_ANSWERS=$(sed -n 's/.*og:description" content="[0-9]\+ problem classes · \([0-9]\+\) verified answers.*/\1/p' site/index.html)
BAND_ANSWERS=$(sed -n 's/.*[0-9]\+ problem classes · \([0-9]\+\) verified answers — growing every day.*/\1/p' site/index.html)
echo "CLASSES='$CLASSES' ANSWERS='$ANSWERS' TITLE='$TITLE_ANSWERS' DESC_C='$DESC_CLASSES' DESC_A='$DESC_ANSWERS' OG='$OG_ANSWERS' BAND='$BAND_ANSWERS'"
if [ "$TITLE_ANSWERS" = "$ANSWERS" ] && [ "$DESC_CLASSES" = "$CLASSES" ] && [ "$DESC_ANSWERS" = "$ANSWERS" ] && [ "$OG_ANSWERS" = "$ANSWERS" ] && [ "$BAND_ANSWERS" = "$ANSWERS" ]; then echo "PARITY PASS (all five extractions non-empty + equal)"; else echo "PARITY FAIL"; fi
